tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind all panels. Charcoal, never pure black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panel body: tables, chart frame, rail sections.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Header bar, table header rows, section title bars, input fields.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Selected toggle, hovered row, pressed state.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Chart plot area and other recessed instrument wells.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows, cells and panels.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, toggles) and axis baselines. 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and live values, on bg, surface, surface-2 and surface-3.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units, column headers, secondary context, on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: axis ticks, timestamps, unavailable values. 4.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (2px) and the active tab underline.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: State: normal / online / within target. Text or glyph on any surface.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: State: warning / caution. Text or glyph on any surface.

tokens.name: fault
tokens.usage: State: fault / offline-required. Text or glyph on any surface.

tokens.name: advisory
tokens.usage: State: advisory. Informational deviation that needs no action yet.

tokens.name: sensor
tokens.usage: State: sensor error. A measurement problem, not an equipment problem.

tokens.name: offline
tokens.usage: State: offline / inactive / not installed.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind an ok badge or an ok diagnostic row, only when the row is expanded.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind caution rows and the warning cell of the summary strip.

tokens.name: fault-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind fault rows.

tokens.name: advisory-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind advisory rows.

tokens.name: sensor-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind sensor-error rows.

tokens.name: side-low
tokens.usage: Low side / suction identity: column header rule and chart series. Never a fill.

tokens.name: side-high
tokens.usage: High side / liquid identity: column header rule and chart series. Never a fill.

tokens.name: series-supply
tokens.usage: Chart series: supply air, supply static, delta-T.

tokens.name: series-return
tokens.usage: Chart series: return air, return static.

tokens.name: series-outdoor
tokens.usage: Chart series: outdoor air.

tokens.name: series-ink
tokens.usage: Chart series: totals (TESP, capacity).

tokens.name: bar-bg
tokens.usage: Header bar ground in both themes. Near the logo's black so the transparent logo sits on it.

tokens.name: bar-bg-2
tokens.usage: Controls inside the header bar (select, buttons).

tokens.name: bar-bg-3
tokens.usage: Pressed or hovered control inside the header bar.

tokens.name: bar-line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the header bar.

tokens.name: bar-line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders inside the header bar. 3:1 on bar-bg.

tokens.name: bar-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bar-bg.

tokens.name: bar-muted
tokens.usage: Labels and secondary text on bar-bg.

tokens.name: bar-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on bar-bg.

tokens.name: bar-ok
tokens.usage: ok state on bar-bg.

tokens.name: bar-caution
tokens.usage: caution state on bar-bg.

tokens.name: bar-advisory
tokens.usage: advisory state on bar-bg.

tokens.name: bar-sensor
tokens.usage: sensor-error state on bar-bg.

tokens.name: bar-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring and active tab on bar-bg.

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: The logo's native black (cover, print). The UI logo is transparent and sits on bar-bg.

tokens.name: brand-chrome
tokens.usage: Chrome of the wordmark. Brand surfaces (cover, splash) only.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Reticle green of the logo. Brand surfaces only, never in the UI: green in the UI means ok.

families.sans: Bahnschrift, "DIN Next", "D-DIN", Barlow, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: Key calculated values inside tables: superheat, subcooling, TESP, total capacity.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: System name in the header. The largest text in the product.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Measurement labels and column headers, ink-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Targets, sources, timestamps under a value.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Source tags (MEAS/CALC), channel ids, addresses, firmware versions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a value and its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and tags; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding; control padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; section inner padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; page gutter on tablet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tables, strips, chart wells. The default.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Panel outlines. Nothing is rounder than this.
